magic_signatures.description: 8-byte save identification tag at image offset 0, checked by FUN_080241e0 via FUN_08024d60 memcmp length 8 against ROM tag

fields.name: save_magic
fields.description: 8-byte save identification tag; must match the ROM tag or FUN_080241e0 rejects the save and re-initializes defaults
fields.evidence: FUN_080241e0 validates the save with FUN_08024d60 memcmp of 8 bytes at save offset 0 against the ROM tag pointer _DAT_0802426c; FUN_08024324 and FUN_080247d8 copy these 8 bytes raw (stream bits 0..63).

fields.name: unlock_flags_0
fields.description: Progress/unlock flags 0..7 (LSB-first): 1-bit game-state values at state+8..+22, packed at save bits 64..71
fields.evidence: FUN_08024324 packs 47 consecutive 1-bit state u16 values (state+8, 0x2f entries) starting at save bit 64; FUN_080247d8 unpacks them; FUN_08023ad0 defaults the array to [1,0,0,...].

fields.name: unlock_flags_1
fields.description: Progress/unlock flags 8..15 (LSB-first): 1-bit game-state values at state+24..+38, packed at save bits 72..79
fields.evidence: FUN_08024324 packs 47 consecutive 1-bit state u16 values (state+8, 0x2f entries) starting at save bit 64; FUN_080247d8 unpacks them; FUN_08023ad0 defaults the array to [1,0,0,...].

fields.evidence: FUN_08024324 packs 47 consecutive 1-bit state u16 values (state+8, 0x2f entries) starting at save bit 64; FUN_080247d8 unpacks them; FUN_08023ad0 defaults the array to [1,0,0,...].

fields.evidence: FUN_08024324 packs 47 consecutive 1-bit state u16 values (state+8, 0x2f entries) starting at save bit 64; FUN_080247d8 unpacks them; FUN_08023ad0 defaults the array to [1,0,0,...].

fields.evidence: FUN_08024324 packs 47 consecutive 1-bit state u16 values (state+8, 0x2f entries) starting at save bit 64; FUN_080247d8 unpacks them; FUN_08023ad0 defaults the array to [1,0,0,...].

fields.name: unlock_flags_5
fields.description: Progress/unlock flags 40..46 plus the state+0x68 flag (LSB-first), packed at save bits 104..111
fields.evidence: FUN_08024324 packs flag 40..46 of the 47-entry array plus the state+0x68 1-bit value at save bit 111; FUN_080247d8 unpacks them; FUN_08024080 defaults state+0x68 to 0.

fields.name: packed_class_records
fields.description: Bit-packed class records, save bits 112..727: state+0x6a 1-bit flag at bit 112, then 3 groups x 5 records (state+0x6c stride 0x3c/0xc) each holding a 3-bit selector, three 7-bit values, and a u32 score/prize value stored quantized as value/100 in 17 bits. LSB-first packing; see SPEC.md bit map.
fields.evidence: FUN_08024324 packs 3x5 records (3-bit, 3x7-bit, 16+1-bit of value/100 via FUN_0802cef0) at save bits 113..727; FUN_080247d8 unpacks with (low16|hi<<16)*100; record address helper FUN_08024efc; ROM defaults copied by FUN_08023b90.

fields.name: packed_track_records
fields.description: Bit-packed track records, save bits 728..2162: 7 groups x 5 records (state+0x120 stride 0x3c/0xc) with the same 3-bit + 3x7-bit + 17-bit (value/100) layout as packed_class_records. Last 3 bits spill into byte 270; see SPEC.md bit map.
fields.evidence: FUN_08024324 packs 7x5 records (3-bit, 3x7-bit, 16+1-bit of value/100 via FUN_0802cef0) at save bits 728..2162; FUN_080247d8 unpacks with (low16|hi<<16)*100; record address helper FUN_08024f20; ROM defaults copied by FUN_08023b90.

fields.name: packed_score_records
fields.description: Bit-packed score records, save bits 2163..3667: 7 groups x 5 records (state+0x2c4 stride 0x3c/0xc) each holding a 3-bit selector, three 7-bit values, and a 19-bit u32 score (16+3 bits, unscaled). First 5 bits live in byte 270; see SPEC.md bit map.
fields.evidence: FUN_08024324 packs 7x5 records (3-bit, 3x7-bit, 16+3-bit u32) at save bits 2163..3667; FUN_080247d8 unpacks as low16|hi<<16; record address helper FUN_08024f44; ROM defaults copied by FUN_08023b90.

fields.name: packed_totals_options
fields.description: Save bits 3672..3751: upper/middle bits of three 24-bit career-total counters (state+0x468, state+_DAT_080247c8 region, state+0x470; each packed 16+8 bits at save bits 3668..3739, low bits in the preceding byte) followed by twelve 1-bit option flags (save bits 3740..3751). Counters and flags are zeroed on init.
fields.evidence: FUN_08024324 packs three (16+8-bit) totals then twelve 1-bit values at save bits 3668..3751; FUN_080247d8 unpacks them; FUN_08024080 zeroes state+0x468/+0x46c/+0x470, the 12-entry flag array, and the 7x2 array.

fields.name: packed_season_scores
fields.description: Save bits 3752..4015: fourteen 19-bit season/score counters (7 groups x 2 entries at state+_DAT_080247d0 region, each 16+3 bits, unscaled u32). Final 2 bits of the stream (bits 4016..4017) sit in byte 502 inside reserved_tail.
fields.evidence: FUN_08024324 packs 7x2 (16+3-bit) counters at save bits 3752..4017 with final bit position stored to _DAT_08024d5c; FUN_080247d8 unpacks them; FUN_08024080 zeroes the 7x2 array on init.

fields.name: reserved_tail
fields.description: Unused buffer tail (save bits 4018..4079, includes last 2 stream bits in byte 502): never interpreted by the load path but covered by the checksum, so it must be preserved byte-for-byte
fields.evidence: FUN_080247d8 performs a fixed 4018-bit unpack (final position in _DAT_08024d5c) and never reads save bytes 502..509; FUN_08024d98 checksums the full 512 bytes including this range (FUN_080241e0).

fields.name: save_checksum
fields.description: Stored custom one's-complement checksum word (little-endian). No Schema v2 algorithm expresses it; recompute per SPEC.md after any mutation or the game rejects the save.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802415c stores FUN_08024d98(buffer, 0x200) at save offset 0x1fe; FUN_080241e0 accepts the save only if FUN_08024d60 magic matches and FUN_08024d98(buffer, 0x200) returns 0.
